t: The Bristan Echo Easyfit mono sink mixer tap is a dual-lever kitchen tap designed to control water flow and temperature. Ideal for busy trade professionals installing in modern domestic kitchens, this deck-mounted brass tap features Top Fix Easyfit technology for fast installation from above the sink. The unit includes durable ceramic disc valves for smooth operation and a swivel spout to provide flexible sink access. A polished chrome finish ensures a clean look, while the replaceable aerator maintains a steady water stream. This mixer is suitable for all pressure systems and comes with flexible tails.
